entries.statement: Packet decisions supersede conflicting Chat updates and older Plans; non-conflicting Chat updates remain mandatory.
The current 5.6 Pro concept is modified in place rather than replaced.
Generated index.html and standalone HTML are never hand-edited.
Canonical, concept, and native readiness are reported independently.
Accessibility expansion is outside this scope.
Each temporary or durable thread has one invisibly persisted ComposerBuffer.
Unsent text survives thread switches, restart, and crash without a Draft UI.
Attachments and browser context persist independently of text.
The buffer clears only after durable message admission.
Up/Down history activates only when text is empty and no conflicting pending context exists.
Input history uses prior sent user text from the same thread and does not silently reattach files.
Workflow Message actions target the ordinary composer rather than creating secondary input boxes.
Targeted composer chrome includes a destination ribbon, distinct theme-aware treatment, glyph, and placeholder.
Changing/clearing destination preserves text and attachments.
An ended target cannot silently redirect non-empty composer content.
Primary-agent follow-up queue semantics remain max two, FIFO, Edit, Send Now, and Stop does not auto-send.
Attach icon remains bottom-left inside text entry and attachment tray appears above text entry.
Attachment origins distinguish uploaded snapshots, live project refs, frozen refs, generated artifacts, external refs, clipboard, browser captures, source-control objects, and folders.
Composer thumbnails show a top-edge tracer for processing rather than a conventional progress bar.
Hover reveals an X in the thumbnail top-right; body click opens/preview when supported.
Type, size, source, state, Open, Download and Details are hover-gated rather than permanent transcript text.
Failed processing retains text and sibling attachments and supports Retry/Remove.
Project live references retain the exact revision/hash materialized for each model turn.
Changed-since-message disclosure does not mutate historical truth.
Download returns the exact stored referenced version and never regenerates silently.
Folders use bounded manifests rather than uncontrolled recursive context dumps.
More Info includes producer, related message/workflows, version, hash, trust/freshness, retention, export history and materialization truth.
Visibility in history does not imply inclusion in future prompts; materialization status is recorded per run.
Deletion cannot purge an artifact still referenced by another message, Plan, Goal, workflow, evidence or hold.
Assistant Chat reuses File Manager/FileSafe/Artifact owners and does not create a second transfer/artifact store.
Thread title setting offers Default, None, or an explicit currently available model.
Default title resolver is deterministic and prioritizes eligible local/included, low-pressure, low-latency routes.
Explicit title model has no silent fallback when unavailable.
Title input is a bounded safe excerpt plus safe attachment labels, never attachment bodies or secrets.
Manual rename locks automatic title updates until explicit Regenerate Title.
Late generated title cannot overwrite a manual rename.
Spellcheck is passive red-underlining plus right-click replacement with no Assistant icon/button/provider call/Usage.
Code, paths, URLs, hashes, commands and recognized identifiers are excluded from spellcheck as appropriate.
Goal is one concise objective plus revision and active/paused/blocked/completed lifecycle.
Goal has no title, phase, tranche, child goals, goal-specific budget, mandatory role cast, current action, next action, separate done-when, scope, constraints or attachment fields.
Goal remains extensively usable in Assistant and internal research, ledger-to-Plans, PlanUnit generation, audit/repair and WorkNode-related execution.
Workflow-specific state remains owned by each workflow and is supplied by reference to the Goal-driven agent.
One model turn ending does not complete an unfinished active Goal; host continuation schedules another turn.
User Pause/Cancel/Stop prevents continuation and every automatic resume path.
User edits Goal text directly in Activity Detail; Save is the approved user mutation.
Agent-proposed Goal replacement requires the existing approval system and explicit user instruction.
Agent may create a Goal without second approval when user explicitly requests Goal creation.
Goal hover supports Pause/Resume, Cancel and edit icon; edit opens Activity Detail.
Goal is an Activity domain, not a transcript card.
Goal cancellation removes active projection while preserving minimal history/receipt.
Provider-native Goal loops cannot run concurrently with PM Goal continuation unless exact one-loop mapping is proven.
Goal records and consumers migrate from complex v1 semantics without data loss.
Regular Plan choices are exactly Quick, Standard and Thorough.
Every Plan produces a structured Plan document with Rich default, Markdown toggle and PDF/Markdown export.
Plan content is read-only to the user; all content changes use agent-mediated Revise.
One unfinished current Plan exists per thread and historical Plans remain linear in transcript order.
Plan revisions keep one identity and display Vn; old versions remain immutable.
The same primary control displays Build, Building…, Completed or Canceled.
Building… remains while paused, waiting for quota/window, or otherwise nonterminal; reason is secondary text.
Regular Plan creates only a Plan document and To-Dos; no ledger, PlanUnits, NodeSeeds, WorkNodes, Plan Compile or Orchestrator.
Build freezes exact Plan ID/version/hash, runtime, permissions and project/worktree context.
Build is idempotent and cannot create duplicate PlanRuns/To-Dos.
Build With Crew always opens a configuration modal and starts Plan/Crew/To-Dos atomically.
Build At binds exact Plan version/hash and revision invalidates the schedule.
Send To Planning Wizard bypasses PRD Builder and passes a structured Plan handoff.
A small Assistant Plan is not automatically a NamedPlan; explicit save/promotion/handoff may link one.
An explicit new Plan request closes the old unfinished Plan as Canceled; no Superseded user status.
Regular Plan may use Goal-driven execution only when the user explicitly requests it.
Plan adherence binds material work to Plan step and To-Do identities.
Material Plan divergence requires Revise; constraint conflicts stop affected work.
Deep Plan choices are exactly Thorough, Exhaustive and BrainStorm.
Deep Plan uses a run-scoped native ledger in the background.
The ledger produces a standardized human-readable Plan document.
Before Build, user can request agent-mediated revisions without direct editing.
On Build, Deep Plan creates standard-schema Plan-scoped PlanUnits, then maps them to To-Dos.
Deep Plan PlanUnits retain standard semantics but do not enter the global product PlanUnit index.
Deep Plan does not create NodeSeeds, WorkNodes, Plan Compile, Spec Lock or Orchestrator work.
Deep Plan can be promoted to Planning Wizard with ledger, PlanUnits, sources, answers and attachments intact.
Exhaustive includes more complete research, adversarial alternatives, cross-system effects, migrations, compatibility, security, performance, operations, rollback and uncertainty closure.
BrainStorm is a strict superset of Exhaustive.
Each thread has one current To-Do list and no cross-thread or source-grouped display.
To-Dos support parent/child hierarchy and stable identities.
Leaf To-Dos are bounded independent outcomes rather than multi-day projects.
To-Dos support dependencies, parallel groups, simultaneous in-progress items and out-of-display-order execution.
Visible statuses are pending, in_progress, completed, blocked and skipped.
Waiting on another To-Do is pending with dependency, not blocked.
Verification is neither a To-Do status nor user-visible metadata; validation is a separate To-Do when needed.
Completed To-Dos stay inline with filled dot and strike-through; no Done section.
ToDoController owns stable item mutation, work binding, state transitions, rollups, recovery and projection.
Provider/model whole-list replacement cannot directly mark canonical items complete.
Tool success alone cannot complete a To-Do unless expected outcome is satisfied.
Every completion transition has an item-level cause/evidence reference.
Goal, Plan, Crew and ordinary tasks feed the same thread list without visible source headers.
To-Dos are Activity-only and do not become transcript cards.
Crew, BrainStorm, Review and Chat Room share one participant/run/message/artifact/Usage/recovery/composer-target foundation.
Every invocation opens a configuration modal populated from Settings defaults.
Every participant supports requested/effective model, account, Persona, Skills and tools.
No selected model or Persona is silently substituted.
Each workflow produces a transcript card, expandable recent detail, full panel and Activity domain.
Each participant is clickable to open the exact participant transcript and evidence.
Workflow Message targets the ordinary composer with visual destination chrome.
Pause/resume/cancel preserve truthful state, transcript and artifacts.
Permissions are bounded by the parent ceiling and participants cannot self-authorize.
Multi-Agent Workflows Settings manager has Crew, BrainStorm, Review and Chat Room tabs.
Crew config includes coordinator, roles, models, Personas, context, tools, permissions, dependencies, expected outputs, parallelism, synthesis and limits.
Crew executes delegated work rather than functioning as a discussion-only Chat Room.
Crew Auto is a checkable Multi-Agent submenu item.
Enabling Crew Auto opens its configuration modal before the check becomes active.
Crew Auto criteria cannot widen authority or override an explicit single-agent selection.
Build With Crew binds Crew to exact Plan version and To-Dos.
Crew participant rows open individual transcripts.
BrainStorm is the third Deep Plan option and outputs exactly one Deep Plan.
BrainStorm baseline maximum user-decision questions is 15.
Grill Me increases the effective maximum by a configurable extension; default extension is 10.
Question allowance is shared across all participants and does not reset when Grill Me is enabled mid-flow.
Previously answered and semantically duplicate questions are not repeated.
Researchable factual questions are assigned to agents rather than asked of the user.
BrainStorm is read-only against the target project.
BrainStorm may request permission-gated temporary isolated MCP/tool/package provisioning for research.
Persistent project/host/global installation requires ordinary explicit approval.
Core participants make blind independent proposals before seeing other proposals.
Participants debate, challenge assumptions, request targeted research and may propose hybrids.
Voting records support/oppose/abstain, confidence, reason, evidence and hard-constraint conflicts.
Hard user-constraint violations disqualify an approach regardless of vote count.
Final synthesis preserves material dissent and explains rejected alternatives.
BrainStorm card remains after linked Plan creation and opens full transcript/panel.
Wonderer and Grill Me are additive participants rather than replacements.
Review is a primary Assistant mode with Single Agent and Multi-Pass Review submenu choices.
Single Agent creates a fresh-context reviewer subagent with selected model and Persona.
Multi-Pass supports 1–8 reviewers with default 3 and permits repeated model choices.
Every initial review pass receives a unique attempt and frozen target pack.
Initial review passes run concurrently and blind.
Findings are normalized for likely duplicates without losing origin/evidence.
Reviewers then corroborate findings using confirm, reject, duplicate or uncertain dispositions.
Final adjudication preserves unresolved material disagreement rather than manufacturing consensus.
Reviews of different target hashes cannot silently merge.
Review output is a versioned Rich/Markdown artifact plus concise thread summary.
Review is read-only and never automatically repairs target work.
Confirmed findings can be explicitly sent to agent or converted to To-Dos.
Chat Room is a persistent multi-agent discussion distinct from Crew execution.
Configuration includes participants, moderator, turn policy, mentions/replies, tools, rounds/stop and output.
User can message the room through the ordinary targeted composer.
Room discussion does not automatically create To-Dos, Plans or Goals.
Explicit promotions preserve source lineage into Plan, To-Do, Goal or artifact.
Room transcript and participant sessions survive restart.
Wonderer is implemented as a built-in Persona plus methodology Skill, not Hermes profile infrastructure.
Wonderer explores adjacent domains and overlooked possibilities and connects each lead to the seed topic.
Wonderer output remains hypothesis/lead until researched or decided.
Wonderer is additive in BrainStorm, Crew, Chat Room, PRD Builder and Planning Wizard.
Grill Me uses a shared dependency-aware question frontier and recommended answers.
Grill Me routes factual research to agents and has no implementation authority.
Grill Me appears as an additive option in workflow modals and a Deep Plan submenu footer toggle.
PRD Builder uses Wonderer early and Grill Me near discovery closure when enabled.
Planning Wizard uses Wonderer at topic entry and Grill Me near topic closure with global duplicate prevention.
BSD is a separate passive read-only advisor, not part of Multi-Agent Workflows and not a required reviewer/certifier.
BSD modes are Off, Auto and On with Auto default.
Auto uses deterministic trigger kinds and On evaluates every eligible bounded update within policy.
Each BSD assignment has isolated context/tool session, model/Persona, cursor, epoch, transcript and Usage.
BSD input is a bounded redacted delta plus current constraint/Goal/Plan/PlanUnit/To-Do/evidence refs.
Async concern/critical findings are held and must be reconfirmed against newer work before delivery.
Synchronous frozen safe-point findings may deliver immediately.
Terminal timeout may show unreconfirmed critical advice only with explicit stale labeling and cannot fail/restart primary.
BSD severities are nit, concern and critical; public blocker is not used.
BSD findings have stable dedup/closure identity and unchanged closed findings do not recur.
BSD tools are read-only and exclude mutation, install, approval, credentials, publish and protected auth.
BSD unsafe output is quarantined; one re-prime is allowed then BSD pauses.
BSD failure, quota or unavailability cannot block primary work.
BSD reset/re-prime and epoch fencing cover compaction, fork, rewind, replacement and model/Persona changes.
BSD supports configurable cooldown and bounded catch-up.
BSD can be enabled by stage in PRD Builder, Planning Wizard, PlanUnit, Plan Compile, WorkNode, audit, execution, verification, remediation and certification.
BSD configuration modal appears when explicitly selected for PRD Builder/Planning Wizard and freezes stage bindings.
Compact Context and Context Details show truthful BSD state and identity.
Usage distinguishes BSD calls, no-calls, held/cleared/emitted/suppressed outcomes, cost, stage, latency and quota.
BSD command/event/storage/wiring authority must be closed before implementation-ready status.
Browser supports visible full screenshot, explicit full-scroll-page screenshot, region screenshot and component selection.
Full/region screenshots immediately send an isolated payload to current destination without unrelated composer text.
Component selection shows adjacent instruction bar with Send, menu and persisted last mode.
Component modes are Send Now, Add To Composer List and Insert Component At Cursor.
Add To Composer List creates numbered visible instructions with stable hidden component refs and is distinct from live follow-up queue.
Insert Component At Cursor sends nothing.
BrowserElementContext retains session/page/frame/generation, locator, DOM/component/source/style/rect and optional crop.
Agent has policy-controlled full ordinary internal browser and DevTools access.
Protected authentication browser is always human-only and excluded from capture, DevTools, BSD and persistence.
Schedule Message appears in the wand menu.
Scheduled message freezes exact destination, text, attachments, requested runtime/model/account, time and policy.
Plan Build At binds exact Plan ID/version/hash.
Plan revision invalidates its pending build schedule rather than retargeting silently.
Execution windows support one-time/recurring start, pause, wind-down, days, IANA timezone and local wall-clock DST policy.
Wind-down stops new large work and pauses at a safe checkpoint.
Recurring windows resume the same unfinished run and never start duplicate nightly builds.
Usage exhaustion shows reset time with provider_reported, locally_inferred, user_supplied or unknown truth.
Auto-resume requires explicit per-run consent by default and persists server-side.
Auto-resume revalidates provider/account, Plan version, project/worktree, permissions/tools and execution window.
Manual Stop/Cancel/Pause always overrides schedules, quota reset and Goal continuation.
Scheduled dispatch and resume are idempotent and survive client closure/restart.

entries.statement: Teach is user-to-Puppet-Master durable teaching through /teach and explicit natural language.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: Teacher is a separate Persona that explains Puppet Master and does not equal Teach.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: Automatic Assistant memory at run boundaries/milestones remains enabled under the memory owner.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: Explicit taught/locked memory cannot be silently overridden by automatic memory.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: ELI5 has an application/project default and independent per-thread override.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: ELI5 changes explanation style only and never mutates code, Plan, artifact, evidence or identifiers.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: Debug remains a primary mode and implements target, baseline, instrumentation, reproduction, analysis, repair, verification and cleanup.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: Debug exposes Investigation Context, revalidation, failure/recovery, redaction/revocation and bundle handling.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: Revert Last Agent Edit dispatches the existing whole-turn cmd.chat.revert and is distinct from Rewind.

entries.category: Teach, Teacher, memory, Debug, ELI5, Revert and Context Lens
entries.statement: Context Lens remains a top-of-chat header control and is not in the wand.
Puppet Master owns canonical Goal, Plan, To-Do, tools, MCP, Skills, permissions, subagents, artifacts and workflow state across providers.
Provider-native systems are disabled, redirected, projected or retained as noncanonical observations in that order.
Provider session IDs are correlation only and never replace PM thread/workflow/object identity.
Adapters publish a closed capability matrix with source/currentness.
Each run discloses Full, Constrained or Provider-managed execution control tier.
Host Tool Execution is preferred; delegated execution is isolated and reconciled; reasoning-only is fallback.
Provider-native To-Do/Plan/Goal state cannot directly mutate PM canon.
Fresh Review and blind BrainStorm claims require truly independent sessions or truthful constrained disclosure.
Attachment materialization accurately describes full file, excerpt, vision or omission.
Provider Usage/reset truth is labeled and never fabricated.
Official CLI authentication remains owned by official CLI; direct API credentials remain PM-secure.
Private Usage telemetry is not execution/auth authority.
Current selected concept defaults, menus, questionnaires, history, Context, Orbit/Step Rail, themes and Stop/queue behavior are preserved.
Activity domains include Goal, To-Dos, Subagents, Crew, BrainStorm, Review, Chat Room, Changes and Artifacts when relevant.
Goal and To-Dos are Activity-only; collaborative workflows and Plans have transcript cards.
Plan card defaults Rich and shows exact status control labels.
Multi-agent cards expand recent detail and open full panels.
Participant rows are fully clickable.
Attachment tray, destination ribbon and quota strip coexist without clipping.
All new UI uses existing theme tokens/SVG/motion grammar and avoids left accent bars/excess padding.
Chat updates file is updated by replacing obsolete truth.
Concept source modules are modified and both generated HTML files rebuilt and byte-checked.
Required interactions cannot be implemented as toast-only simulation.
Each semantic system has one owner and Assistant/Settings consume projections rather than duplicate runtime.
Every mutating UI action uses a registered command or explicitly documented local-only view action.
Every command has typed request/result/error/availability, one handler, currentness, permission and idempotency.
Every persisted effect has Event Authority admission or an explicit receipt-only disposition.
Production wiring includes forward and reverse GUI coverage.
Settings managers route domain operations and do not own runtime records.
Generated governance is refreshed only after live source stabilization.
Packet, canonical, concept and native tests are not conflated.
